text: An ancient bell tolled across the land to summon the Lords of Cinder back to link the fire again.
The Lords of Cinder are heroes who previously linked the fire and had their souls fused with it, to be called upon again when the flame fades.
Aldrich, Abyss Watchers, and Yhorm the Giant are among the Lords of Cinder who were resurrected by the bell's toll.
The Unkindled are undead who previously attempted to link the fire and failed because their souls were too weak.

The transitory land of Lothric is a place where multiple kingdoms and ages have converged, containing the homes of all the Lords of Cinder, causing time and space to break down so different eras exist in the same location.
From the Undead Settlement, one path leads to the Cathedral of the Deep and another leads through swamps to Farron Keep, home of the Abyss Watchers.
The Deep is an ancient, stagnant corrupting force connected to the Abyss that lurks beneath reality and gradually seduced the priests of the Cathedral of the Deep.
The Profaned Flame could not be extinguished, burned without fuel, and seemed to actively seek out human life.
By the time the Ashen One arrives, the Kiln of the First Flame resembles a graveyard of ash covering the ruins of fallen kingdoms from past cycles.
At the center of the Kiln, the first flame itself has been reduced to a barely burning ember.
The Painted World of Ariandel is a frozen, snow-covered realm created as a refuge for forlorn and lost souls.
The Dreg Heap is a chaotic landscape where entire collapsed worlds and eras, including fragments of Lothric Castle and Anor Londo, have physically piled atop one another.
The Ringed City functioned more as a prison than a gift, encircled by a protective sigil meant to confine the abyss and contain the Dark Soul's darkness at the edge of the world.
Filianore's prolonged sleep sustained a kind of magic or illusion that kept the Ringed City in its current state.
In this far future wasteland, the sun appears as a dark, bleeding dark sign providing light without warmth.
Once Filianore's egg crumbles, the illusion sustaining the Ringed City vanishes entirely, revealing the true future wasteland beneath it.
In the Age of Ancients, the world was formless, gray, and shrouded in fog with no life, death, heat, cold, light, or dark.
Everlasting dragons, immortal stone-scaled beings, ruled the unchanging world of the Age of Ancients.
The appearance of the First Flame introduced disparity into the world: heat and cold, life and death, light and dark.
Hollows were humanoid creatures who emerged from the darkness around the First Flame, drawn to its warmth.
Four beings discovered Lord Souls within the First Flame, transforming them from hollow vessels into beings of great power.
Unlike the other Lord Souls, the Dark Soul did not grant immediate power; the Furtive Pygmy split it apart and distributed fragments to create humanity.
As the First Flame began to fade, the power of the gods weakened along with it, while humanity's inner darkness grew stronger.
The repeating cycle of the Age of Fire fading and being relinked became progressively weaker, with each linking buying less time than the last.
The Kingdom of Lothric was built with the singular purpose of breeding and preparing the perfect vessel to link the First Flame.

The Painted World operates on a cycle where it rots over time and must eventually be burned away and repainted to renew itself, but Friede has stopped this cycle by keeping the painting alive through Ariandel's suffering.
